graph.title: Squidman Escape (Space Police police speeder)
notes: KEPT DELIBERATELY - the remaining 'separate group' is the green '100' banknote tile (b32), and it is not a real connectivity error. In this booklet the tile is only ever held in Squidman's minifigure hand (cover and page 2); it never attaches to the speeder or to any other listed piece. Minifigures are not in the official parts list, so the hand it connects to is not a node, and inventing a joined/contact edge to a speeder piece would be false. The speeder is the only model built from the listed pieces; the tile is a loose accessory piece.
The booklet's pictures are small; exact stud positions (which stud of which piece) are best-effort inferences. Piece-to-piece connectivity follows the step pictures.
Minifigure assembly (Squidman page 2, pilot in step 12) is omitted because minifigure parts are not in the parts list.

Main body: plate b1 sits on offset lower plate b2; hinge b3 and Technic brick b6 sit on b2's exposed studs; the two 1x4 side-stud bricks sit on b1; blue pins go through the Technic brick and carry the green cones.
Curved wedges b15/b17 attach sideways onto the side studs of b4/b5 (SNOT); which wedge goes on which side is inferred. Stickers (b33) are put on both wedges and the flag.
Cockpit: handles b12/b13 and jumper b14 fill gray plate b9; trans slopes and the clip tile sit on the studs of b14/b13; handlebars clip into the clip tile; flag clips onto the handle bars.

Rear assembly (steps 1-6 of pages 9-10): black 2x2 plate with hinge below, white side-handle plate and red plate on top, two brackets clamped on the red plate with the two sloped wedges on them. The stacking order is inferred. It joins the body via the black 1-finger hinge b25 into the white 2-finger hinge b3 (step 11).
